response.overview: Lewis Rossignol is a South Portland based visual artist. After many years working blue-collar jobs, at 37 years old he decided to go back to art school. Propelled by his distinctive style, Lewis has been able to sustain a career selling his original work as well as taking on high profile commissions for artists like Drew Taggart of The Chainsmokers and Tyler the Creator. Lewis is open about how creative endeavors like drawing is one of the only remedies he’s found for his condition, Tourette’s Syndrome.
response.title: Insuppressible: Lewis Rossignol
